name: HuaDan
source:
"Huadan" is an otome romance adventure game set in the early era of Taiwan. Players will take on the role of the female protagonist, experiencing the social customs and folk culture of that time, and even embark on romantic relationships with different male leads. As the story progresses, players will encounter various branching choices...

Tragic? Angsty? Joyful? Sweet?
